message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (18 June 1815) resulted in roughly **23,000 total casualties**—killed, wounded, or missing.  In more detail:

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| French & allied (Napoleon’s forces) | 25,000–30,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch & Prussian (Allied forces) | 20,000–25,000 |

These figures are rounded estimates drawn from contemporary military reports and modern historical analyses.
